column2: ext4: add a shrinker to release checkpointed buffers

column1: Current metadata buffer release logic in bdev_try_to_free_page() have
a lot of use-after-free issues when umount filesystem concurrently
it is difficult to fix directly because ext4 is the only user of
s_op->bdev_try_to_free_page callback and we may have to add more special
refcount or lock that is only used by ext4 into the common vfs layer
which is unacceptable.
One better solution is remove the bdev_try_to_free_page callback
the real problem is we cannot easily release journal_head on the
checkpointed buffer
column2: so try_to_free_buffers() cannot release buffers and

column1: page under memory pressure
column2: which is more likely to trigger

column1: out-of-memory. So we cannot remove the callback directly before we find
another way to release journal_head.
This patch introduce a shrinker to free journal_head on the checkpointed
transaction. After the journal_head got freed
could free buffer properly.
